title: Reuse Threshold Explorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: MicroSims

Reuse
Thresholds

description: A p5.js explorer of the reuse and template thresholds used by find-similar-templates.py in reuse mode. Using only the score ranges and the Coulomb's law probe reported in the tool's README, learners move both thresholds, see which parts of each range land in the wrong band, and weigh missed reuse against false reuse.
audience: Teachers, instructional designers, learning-technology developers and learning-analytics practitioners (college undergraduate and professional development)

learningObjectives: The learner will judge where the reuse and template thresholds should sit by moving them and observing which documented example scores are misclassified, and will justify why a conservative reuse threshold trades missed reuse for fewer false reuse.
prerequisites: Similarity search and reuse before build (Chapter 15)

accessibility.notes: Native sliders, button and checkbox; misclassified parts are marked by an outline and listed in words with check and cross marks

controls.label: Reuse threshold
controls.purpose: Scores at or above it are sent to reuse

controls.label: Template threshold
controls.purpose: Scores at or above it (and below reuse) are sent to template

controls.label: Show misclassified
controls.purpose: Outline and list the parts of each range that fall in the wrong band

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Evaluate a decision rule against documented evidence, then justify a choice
keyQuestions: Which reuse thresholds separate the documented same-concept and related ranges?
Why is a false reuse costlier than a missed reuse?
How much evidence stands behind the reported ranges?
commonMisconceptions: A higher threshold is always safer
A similarity score is a verdict rather than a distance
The bands have been validated against teachers' judgments
assessmentOpportunities: Naming the clean interval for the reuse threshold
Classifying each misrouting by error type
Written justification of a threshold choice

dataSources: search-microsims repository, src/find-similar-templates/README.md (thresholds and score ranges, recalibrated 2026-07-15)
search-microsims repository, src/find-similar-templates/find-similar-templates.py (comment on keeping REUSE_THRESHOLD conservative)
